maintenance_led.reason: Sells new plumbing, drinking fountains, partitions and water heaters mainly for new construction, with some retrofit; not mainly aftermarket maintenance.

publicly_funded.reason: Customers are mostly private commercial builders, contractors and building owners; some institutional and municipal exposure, but not mainly government-paid.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows mainly through product sales and innovation; Elkay merger and a few brand acquisitions like Hadrian, not a steady roll-up.

mission_critical.reason: Specified plumbing fixtures, drinking fountains and partitions can be switched on new projects; backflow and fire valves have some code-spec stickiness.

notes: Revenue split between new construction and repair/retrofit is not stated on the site; the answers are based on typical product mix.
